description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You attempt a Crafting check, or you roll on the Slippage Table.

Requirement You petitioned the Foreman at 6th level or later, leaving a worthy scrap-offering at a shrine.

The weld takes, because He says it takes. Choose one: treat the triggering Crafting check as a success without rolling; or the triggering Slippage result does not occur and has no effect. You do not reroll the Slippage — it simply did not happen.
